PATIENT PROFILE

41-year-old male
Congenital horseshoe kidney
Prediabetes (managed with Dexcom Stelo CGM)

DIAGNOSIS NOTE: Two source records conflict on histology — one states Mixed Germ Cell Tumor (65% Seminoma / 35% Embryonal Carcinoma); the other states Mixed Non-Seminomatous Germ Cell Tumor. Marker elevations (AFP, β-hCG) at diagnosis are more consistent with non-seminomatous disease. This should be confirmed against the original pathology report.
